assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production background for an original literary Japanese-style visual novel, landscape 16:9 composition. A small weathered riverside town's amateur theatre workshop on a bright early spring afternoon, empty of people. Three mismatched wooden chairs, one upside down with a freshly repaired rear leg and a conspicuous dark walnut wooden patch; a workbench with hand tools, screws, a folded pale canvas backdrop showing an unfinished quiet seaside scene, an open worn script without legible writing, a kettle and ordinary mugs. Tall wooden window on the RIGHT looking onto an alley with white plaster buildings and a modest peach tree, sunlight showing dust in air, theatrical wings and a few warm stage lights in the distance on the LEFT. View from eye level as if standing in the room; coherent architecture, believable space, foreground area clear for waist-up characters. Evocative hand-painted gouache / detailed oil-sketch atmosphere with delicate anime-background craftsmanship, subtle canvas grain, luminous but grounded, restrained spring greens, warm ochre wood, cool blue window shadows. Gentle lived-in imperfection, literary and intimate, not fantasy palace, not neon, not photorealism, not a UI mockup. Whole room readable, no extreme fisheye, no lettering, no logo, no people. The chair's repair patch is a meaningful recurring clue, make it visible but natural.

Same original hand-painted literary visual-novel world. Front row view of an intimate low stage, 8 mismatched wooden chairs, simple door frame/shoe cabinet for a modest homecoming play, grey teal wings, warm amber lights and evening blue windows, small donation jar without text, bucket under roof leak, no people, stage center clear for sprites.
